svg.text: THE LAUNCH HIERARCHY IN 3-D: gridDim AND blockDim ARE 3-D VECTORS
gridDim = how many blocks per axis | blockDim = how many threads per block axis | total threads = gridDim.x*blockDim.x x gridDim.y*blockDim.y x gridDim.z*blockDim.z
global position = blockIdx * blockDim + threadIdx, per axis (component-wise)
gx = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x | gy = blockIdx.y * blockDim.y + threadIdx.y | gz = blockIdx.z * blockDim.z + threadIdx.z
x is the fastest dimension, then y, then z - the hardware linearises threads in that order (Section 3.5)
